title: The Ebola outbreak nobody's talking about

head: THE OUTBREAK
NO ONE'S TALKING ABOUT
scenes.say: There's an Ebola outbreak in Congo right now. And almost nobody is talking about it.
scenes.show: There's an Ebola outbreak in Congo right now. And almost nobody is talking about it.

head: EBOLA
IS BACK
scenes.say: It started in Ituri, in eastern Congo. It has now reached six provinces.
scenes.show: It started in Ituri, in eastern Congo. It has now reached six provinces.

head: CASES
scenes.say: As of September twenty-second: seven thousand, seven hundred and seventy-three confirmed cases. Three thousand, seven hundred and fifty-nine people dead.
scenes.show: As of September 22nd: 7,773 confirmed cases. 3,759 people dead.

head: FASTEST
EVER
scenes.say: It hit one thousand cases in just forty days. The twenty eighteen outbreak took two hundred and thirty-five.
scenes.show: It hit 1,000 cases in just 40 days. The 2018 outbreak took 235.

head: NO APPROVED
VACCINE
scenes.say: This is Bundibugyo, a rare strain. Today's Ebola vaccines were built for a different one.
scenes.show: This is Bundibugyo, a rare strain. Today's Ebola vaccines were built for a different one.

head: 2ND LARGEST
IN HISTORY
scenes.say: It's now the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded. Only West Africa, in twenty fourteen, was bigger.
scenes.show: It's now the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded. Only West Africa, in 2014, was bigger.

head: EBOLA IS
SPREADING SOUTH
scenes.say: Cases in Ituri are slowing. But in North Kivu, they're up seventy-three percent in three weeks.
scenes.show: Cases in Ituri are slowing. But in North Kivu, they're up 73% in three weeks.

head: A RACE
AGAINST TIME
scenes.say: A vaccine trial is now underway. More than two thousand health workers have already had a dose.
scenes.show: A vaccine trial is now underway. More than 2,000 health workers have already had a dose.

head: WHY ISN'T THIS
ON YOUR FEED?
scenes.say: So why isn't this on your feed? That's the blind spot.
scenes.show: So why isn't this on your feed? That's the blind spot.

head: SEND THIS TO
SOMEONE WHO HASN'T HEARD
scenes.say: Send this to someone who hasn't heard.
scenes.show: Send this to someone who hasn't heard.
